mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expense ORDER BY spent_on DESC, expense_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trips, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, t.start_date, t.end_date) + 1), 0) AS total_travel_days, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_budget), 0) AS total_budget, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.start_date <= #{today} AND t.end_date >= #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ongoing_trips, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_date < #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished_trips, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.start_date > #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS upcoming_trips, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM expense e JOIN trip owned ON owned.trip_id = e.trip_id WHERE owned.user_id = #{userId}) AS total_actual_expense FROM trip t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT i.* FROM itinerary_item i JOIN trip_day d ON d.day_id = i.day_id WHERE d.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY d.trip_date, i.sort_order, i.item_id
